mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO category_orders (user_id, category_id, type, sort_order) SELECT #{userId}, c.category_id, c.type, c.sort_order FROM categories c WHERE c.type = #{type} AND c.is_active = 1 AND c.user_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT co.category_id as categoryId, c.name as name, co.type as type, (CASE WHEN c.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isCustom, co.sort_order as sortOrder FROM category_orders co JOIN categories c ON co.category_id = c.category_id WHERE co.user_id = #{userId} AND co.type = #{type} AND c.is_active = 1 ORDER BY co.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (user_id, name, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{type})

INSERT INTO category_orders (user_id, category_id, type, sort_order) SELECT #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM category_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type}
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET is_active = 0 WHERE category_id = #{customCategoryId} AND user_id = #{userId}
